theorems.name: Submission.ecf_cp_gc_det_shear
theorems.statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (a : Euclid P) (w : Fin k → Euclid P) (c : Fin k → ℝ), Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin (k + 1) => inner ℝ ((Fin.cons (a - ∑ l, c l • w l) w : Fin (k + 1) → Euclid P) i) ((Fin.cons (a - ∑ l, c l • w l) w : Fin (k + 1) → Euclid P) j)) = Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin (k + 1) => inner ℝ ((Fin.cons a w : Fin (k + 1) → Euclid P) i) ((Fin.cons a w : Fin (k + 1) → Euclid P) j))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
